ref.mira: She is a pale woman with long silver-grey hair under a black nun's habit trimmed in white; her left arm is a white-furred wolf foreleg with black claws.
ref.kai: He is a wiry young cook in a black chef jacket with a cream towel over his shoulder, short locs tied up, burn scars on his forearms, his right hand black and cracked with gold.
ref.dutch: He is a heavy-set older man with slicked-back steel-grey hair, a long navy coat over grey work clothes, a ring of keys on his belt and a mop in one hand.
ref.coo: He is a pigeon postmaster: a full-body grey pigeon with green and purple neck feathers, standing upright on two pink bird legs, wearing a navy postal uniform jacket and cap with a gold envelope badge and a brown mail satchel.
ref.bru: She is a young woman with messy black hair and a pencil stuck in it, in a white shirt and navy vest.
ref.kagemaru: He is a tall hooded card fixer in a long dark purple cloak with the hood up so his face is in shadow except a wide white grin, white gloves, a gold ring.
ref.lexi: She is a librarian witch with dark skin, a wide-brimmed dark purple witch hat, a long black braid, an eyepatch, a dark robe with purple bow, holding a book.
ref.wen: She is a cheerful café owner with her hair in a bun, round glasses, a beige cardigan over a striped top, a long apron and comfortable shoes.
ref.ayo: He is a big dark-skinned blacksmith with a grey beard, short braids, brass goggles on his forehead, a green leather apron over a work shirt and heavy boots.
ref.aigerim: She is a young woman with long black hair, a red beret with a white feather, a red embroidered coat with gold trim and dark boots.
ref.chad: He is a slick consultant with grey swept-back hair, a grey suit, red shirt and white tie, polished shoes.
ref.seymour: He is a knight in full steel plate armour with a closed helmet and red plume, a blue tabard with a gold gear emblem, carrying a clipboard.

new.hobb: an old grumpy locksmith, short and a little stooped, bald with white mutton-chop whiskers and a squint, small round spectacles, a brown leather apron full of keys and picks over a rolled-sleeve shirt, a big iron key ring on his belt
new.pell: a sergeant of the castle gate guard, a tall broad-shouldered man in his forties with a neat black moustache, a steel kettle helmet, a padded blue-and-grey gambeson with a sergeant's stripes, a halberd held upright beside him, stiff by-the-book posture
new.tess: a young lamplighter woman with freckles and a red-brown ponytail under a soft cap, a short green coat, brown trousers and boots, carrying a long brass lamplighter's pole with a small flame at the tip resting on her shoulder
new.doug: a tired office-worker type man in his thirties with short brown hair, a blue cardigan jacket over a cream shirt, grey trousers, a lanyard badge around his neck and a coffee mug in hand, slightly slumped
new.hollis: an ostler who keeps horses at a coach house, a lean weathered man in his fifties with grey stubble and a flat cap, a brown waistcoat over a linen shirt, riding breeches and tall boots, a ledger and pencil in his hands
new.odu: a cheerful harbourmaster, a big round-bellied dark-skinned man with a short beard and a wide grin, a navy peacoat with brass buttons, a captain's flat cap, a rolled shipping manifest under one arm
new.fennel: a quiet orchard keeper woman in her thirties with long light-brown hair in a loose braid, a wide straw sun hat, an earth-green dress with rolled sleeves and a canvas apron, a basket of apples on her hip
new.captain: the captain of the castle guard, a tall stern woman in her fifties with short grey hair and a scar on her cheek, a polished steel breastplate over a deep red coat, a dark cloak, a sword at her hip and a brass key on a chain
new.kevin: a mysterious hooded stranger in a long dark grey hooded cloak that hides the whole body down to the ground, the hood's opening completely black except one small glowing pale blue round eye, a stolen brass badge pinned on the chest, slightly boxy rigid shoulders
new.townsfolk-1: an ordinary townswoman in a plain blue dress and white headscarf carrying a bread basket
new.townsfolk-2: an ordinary townsman in a brown tunic and cap with a sack over his shoulder
new.townsfolk-3: an old townsman with a walking stick, grey beard and a green coat
